objective: Prove: if [[n-, n-], n-] = 0, then for every finitely presented group pi with H^1(pi; F_p) = H^2(pi; F_p) = 0 and every surjection psi onto C2, |Hom_psi(pi, N x| C2)| = |Z^1(pi; F_p^psi)|^(dim n-), so counting on closed 3-manifolds with H1(M; F_p) = 0 is polynomial in every class c < p. Show the condition is equivalent to the vanishing of all odd Lie words of degree at least 3 in n-, and check the formula against independent counts.
status: Proved by TRIPLE-SYSTEM-20261027-001A-P001: if the Lie triple system n- of the involution is abelian ([[n-, n-], n-] = 0, equivalently all odd words of degree at least 3 in n- vanish), then for every group with H^1 and H^2 with F_p coefficients zero, |Hom_psi(pi, N x| C2)| = |Z1(pi; F_p^psi)|^(dim n-) and every homomorphism lies in the class-2 subgroup exp(n- + [n-, n-]) x| <theta>. So counting is polynomial on closed 3-manifolds with H1(M; F_p) = 0, in every class c < p. Independent counts and gadget surgeries agree.
title: An abelian Lie triple system makes counting polynomial in every class
